posts.title: AI Automation Roadmap for Small Teams
posts.excerpt: A practical 30-day roadmap to start automation without over-engineering your stack.
posts.content:
# AI Automation Roadmap for Small Teams

Small teams can ship AI automation quickly by focusing on one business KPI first.

## Week 1: Pick one process

Choose a repetitive workflow such as lead qualification or support triage.

## Week 2: Build a minimal workflow

Connect one input, one model step, and one output.

## Week 3: Add quality checks

Use human review on sensitive outputs and log errors.

## Week 4: Measure and iterate

Track response time, conversion, or cost reduction and improve each week.

posts.seo_description: 30-day implementation plan for AI automation in lean teams.

posts.title: How to Modernize a Legacy Yii2 App Safely
posts.excerpt: Reduce risk while upgrading old Yii2 codebases with an incremental delivery approach.
posts.content:
# How to Modernize a Legacy Yii2 App Safely

Legacy systems should be modernized in slices, not big-bang rewrites.

## Start with high-impact modules

Pick areas that improve customer experience or reduce support load.

## Add API boundaries

Wrap old logic behind stable endpoints before moving deeper layers.

## Keep regression checks

Add smoke tests and monitoring for each deployed slice.

## Deliver in milestones

Short milestones reduce risk and keep business stakeholders aligned.

posts.title: Pinterest + Blog Content Engine: End-to-End Setup
posts.excerpt: Generate, publish, and distribute content through one automation pipeline.
posts.content:
# Pinterest + Blog Content Engine: End-to-End Setup

A single content pipeline can generate images, publish blogs, and push Pinterest pins.

## Content generation

Use an AI writer to create title, excerpt, and markdown article.

## Image generation

Generate vertical images optimized for Pinterest discovery.

## Publishing

Save post metadata in Supabase and publish to your blog endpoint.

## Distribution

Create pins with link-back to the blog article and monitor click-through rate.
posts.seo_description: Automate content creation and Pinterest distribution from one workflow.
